column1: # What docs/_docs/internals/interactive-multi-reader.md §8 (the I91 table, I92–I96) says of each cache, as
# field-key regex, kind, protection (a regex; `*` for any), and the row it comes from. `StateMap.scala` reports every
# row whose fields the rules place differently, and every row that matches no field.

column4: NamedType lastDenotation/lastSymbol/checkedPeriod: a Published period and its Payloads, release/acquire (I36, I78)
Symbol.lastDenot/checkedPeriod: a Published period and its Payload (I36)
PreDenotation.asSeenFrom: one immutable value in a volatile field (I78)
PreDenotation.asSeenFrom: the plain fields are batch only (StampedCachesTest exception)
MatchType.reduced: one immutable value in a volatile field (I79)
MatchType.reduced: the plain fields are batch only
PackageClassDenotation.packageObjs: an immutable holder, computed under a claim (I79)
packageObjs: the plain fields are batch only
LazyRef.myRef: a `Once`, stored by its `get` under the reference's claim (I57)
LazyRef.computed: a claim per lazy reference with parallel readers (I57)
InheritedCacheImpl.dependent: batch only; a concurrent base pulls, by the structure epoch
InheritedCacheImpl.checkedPeriod: a stamp without a value, a stale read only checks again
MemberNamesImpl.cache, BaseDataImpl.cache/valid/locked: computed under the cache's claim (Sharing.claim)
ClassDenotation's member and base-type caches: one Stamped field each
the stamped caches in Types held in one Stamped cell each
memberNamesCache, baseDataCache: class 1, fixed (I92), read once
Type.mightBeProvisional: class 1, fixed (I93)
AnnotatedType.isRefining: one byte, as myGround (I94)
RecType.openedWithPrefix: batch only; a concurrent base keeps the guard per reader (Reader.openedRecTypes)
Namer.nestedTyper: class 1, fixed (I90): created under the monitor, published through a volatile field
TypeDefCompleter.myTypeParams: class 1, fixed (I91): indexed under the monitor, published volatile
OrderingConstraint.myUninstVars: class 1, fixed, unproven (I91): filled first, published volatile
fullNameCache: class 2, a lost update loses an entry
class 2: one field, the same value from any writer, or an interned or structurally equal one
LambdaParam.myVariance: class 2
SymDenotation myThisType/myTypeRef/myTargetName/myTypeParams: class 2
ImportInfo mySym/myUnimported/mySelectorInfo: class 2
Implicits mySingletonClass: class 2
Implicits synthesizer: class 2, interchangeable
CompilationUnit.myAssignmentSpans: class 2
LazyType.mySourceModule/myModuleClass: class 2, found by name in the owner's scope
the capture checker's: phases after typer that the interactive compiler does not run
CapturedVars.myRefInfo: a phase after typer
TypeMap.variance, ApproximatingTypeMap.expandingBounds: a map is one traversal's
SymDenotation's own state, written by its completion under its claim
myDecls: the denotation's own state, set by its completer
TypeVar inst/currentOrigin/owningState: not caches, a type variable's, which belongs to one typer state
Symbol.myDefTree: not lazy, assigned by its owner
Trees.myMods: not lazy, assigned by its owner
TreeUnpickler's address maps, root owner and seen roots: a TASTy file's state, a Claimed[unpickler.type, _] field, under the claim on its file
a lazy read's kept tree and the owner tree's children: a TASTy file's state, a Claimed[unpickler.type, _] field, under the claim on its file

TreeProvider.myTrees: the root trees kept under the file's claim with -Yretain-trees, a Claimed[provider.type, _] field (kind: @cache; its lazy init stores a Claimed value, which the C.lazy-init rule does not see)
